how_to_apply: Attend the Walk-In Interview in the Seminar room, Department of Microbiology, NEIGRIHMS, Shillong on the date fixed for the post at 9:30 AM.
Bring all original documents, attested Xerox copies of all testimonials and CV.
Currently employed candidates must bring a No Objection Certificate from the current employer.
No candidate will be permitted to attend the interview after the assigned time.
Attend on 25 November 2026, reporting at 9:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary contractual basis up to 31st March, 2027, co-terminus with the Scheme Engagement for one year initially, extendable as per performance review and continuation of the scheme, as per ICMR guidelines Engagement may be terminated by either side with one month's notice or one month's emoluments in lieu of notice Provident Fund, pension, LTC, medical reimbursement, staff quarters and other regular-employee benefits are not admissible No right to claim regular appointment

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Scientist-I (Medical), 1 Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Seminar room, Department of Microbiology, NEIGRIHMS, Shillong.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Research Scientist-I (Medical): maximum 35 years; Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS): maximum 25 years. Relaxation: Relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 67,000 + HRA as admissible for Research Scientist-I (Medical), Rs. 18000 (consolidated) for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Research Scientist-I (Medical): MBBS/ BVSc/ BDS Degree with 2 years Research/ Teaching experience/ MD in Microbiology/ Pathology/ PSM from a recognised University. MTS: High School/ Matric or equivalent from a recognised board. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate may have to do shift duties on holidays and when required during an epidemic. Selected candidates must submit an undertaking on judicial stamp paper notarized by an authorized notary.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Currently employed candidates without a No Objection Certificate will not be considered for interview. Candidates arriving after the assigned time will not be permitted to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Research Scientist-I (Medical): Verification of original documents followed by personal interview only for eligible candidates. MTS: Verification of original documents and skill test for eligible candidates; those who qualify in the skill test attend the interview on the same day. Research Scientist-I (Medical): verification of original documents followed by personal interview only for eligible candidates on 26-11-2026. MTS: only candidates who qualify in the skill test attend the interview on the same day.
